# citation.inator importer (preview, unreleased)

`citation-import.mjs` (the import bundle) and `citation-compiler.mjs` (the browser compiler) are citation.inator's
bundles at **0.4.0-preview.3** (commit `0e2a9b4`), copied
unchanged so draft.inator's importer and compiled preview can be built and tested before 0.4.0 is out. It
is not a release. Replace them with the same files from citation.inator's v0.4.0 release before this reaches a draft.inator
release.
